Qualcomm native GDSC regulator API adapter

Some legacy Qualcomm display/IOMMU/bus clients consume a GDSC through the
regulator API, while the clock controller owns its actual sequencing as a
generic power domain. This adapter uses runtime-PM references to that real
domain and preserves regulator enable/disable notifiers. It never maps or
programs GDSC registers and never supplies voltage/mode operations.

Required properties:
- compatible: "qcom,genpd-regulator"
- regulator-name: unique supply name
- power-domains: exactly one real native GDSC provider reference

Voltage constraints and regulator mode masks must not be specified. Do not
use this for battery/charger/DPDM supplies or for a physical voltage rail.
The parent genpd provider must probe before this status-only supply can bind.
